description: Pinned upstream npm runtime specimens. Original runtime code, package manifests and licenses are copied byte-for-byte from integrity-verified npm archives. Project lockfiles pin each archive. Readmes, development dependencies and type declarations are not installed. Three small CommonJS packages are an initial offline band, not a representative top-N npm claim.

cases.description: is-number@7.0.0: actual published implementation distinguishes finite numbers and numeric strings from non-finite/coercion-like values without invoking object coercion.
